verdict.rationale: Checkout.com Issuing documents spend controls that can block industries and states that card checks and spend controls drive authorization decisions, which covers merchant-category blocklists applied at authorization time. Its accept/reject rules are a generic building block, not a documented merchant lock. missing for 10: explicit MCC allowlists, single-merchant locks, MCC-level configuration detail in API docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can restrict where a card works — merchant category (MCC) allowlists and blocklists, and single-merchant locks — applied at authorization time

citations.quote: Set granular limits like transaction amounts, blocked industries, and card expiry dates.
We can manage decisions for you with card checks and spend controls, or send requests to you for complete control.
manage cardholders' spending limits, locations, and velocity
